perspective: Contoso is the customer buying software or services from a vendor.

limitation_of_liability.title: Limitation of liability
limitation_of_liability.standard_position: Vendor liability is capped at no less than the fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim. The cap does not apply to confidentiality breaches, data protection breaches, or indemnified claims.
limitation_of_liability.acceptable_fallback: Cap of 6 to 11 months of fees, with the same carve-outs.
non_standard_signals: Cap applies to data protection breaches or indemnified claims
Contoso's liability is uncapped while the vendor's is capped

payment_terms.title: Payment terms
payment_terms.standard_position: Net 45 days or longer from receipt of a correct invoice.
non_standard_signals: Payment due in fewer than 30 days
Payment in advance for more than 12 months

termination.title: Termination
termination.standard_position: Contoso may terminate for convenience with 30 days' written notice and receives a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees.
termination.acceptable_fallback: Termination for convenience with up to 90 days' notice.
non_standard_signals: No refund of prepaid fees on termination

auto_renewal.title: Renewal
auto_renewal.standard_position: No automatic renewal, or automatic renewal that Contoso can cancel with 30 days' notice, with price increases capped at 5% per renewal.
auto_renewal.acceptable_fallback: Cancellation notice of up to 60 days and price increases up to 7%.
non_standard_signals: Uncapped renewal price increases or increases above 7%

indemnification.title: Indemnification
indemnification.standard_position: Mutual indemnification, including vendor indemnity for third-party intellectual property infringement claims.
non_standard_signals: No vendor indemnity for IP infringement

governing_law.title: Governing law
governing_law.standard_position: Laws of the State of Washington, with exclusive venue in the state or federal courts in King County, Washington.
governing_law.acceptable_fallback: Delaware or New York law and venue.
non_standard_signals: Governing law or venue in any state other than Washington, Delaware, or New York

data_protection.title: Data protection
data_protection.standard_position: When the vendor processes personal data, a data processing addendum (DPA) is incorporated and the vendor notifies Contoso of breaches within 72 hours.
data_protection.acceptable_fallback: DPA incorporated with breach notification within 7 days.
non_standard_signals: Personal data processed without a DPA
